title: user.status_updated
description: An operator froze or released a user. Frozen means no login, no token refresh, no API key, and the spot account takes no orders and no withdrawals; an access token already issued lasts its fifteen minutes. No account_id and no sequence: a user is not an account.

version.description: User row version after the change; increases on every edit.

reason.description: Operator's reason, recorded in the audit trail.
